# ToF spectrometer instrument file
# Parameters: lambda=6, dlambda=0.05, rpm=10000, coh=Rb_liq_coh.sqw, inc=Rb_liq_inc.sqw, tmin=0.01806, tmax=0.01826

# Define constants
const double PI = 3.141592653589793;
const double RAD2DEG = 180.0 / PI;
const double K2V = 3956.0 / 1e4; # m/s per Angstrom
const double VS2E = 81.81; # meV per (m/s)^2

# Define instrument parameters
param double lambda (6) "Wavelength [Angstrom]";
param double dlambda (0.05) "Delta wavelength [Angstrom]";
param double rpm (10000) "Chopper rotation speed [RPM]";
param string coh ("Rb_liq_coh.sqw") "Coherent scattering file";
param string inc ("Rb_liq_inc.sqw") "Incoherent scattering file";
param double tmin (0.01806) "Minimum time of flight [s]";
param double tmax (0.01826) "Maximum time of flight [s]";

# Calculate derived quantities
double Chopper2Detector = 11.97 + 2.143 + 0.165;
double KI = 2 * PI / lambda;
double Vi = K2V * fabs(KI);
double EI = VS2E * Vi * Vi;
double time_elastic = 252.78 * Chopper2Detector * lambda * 1e-6;

# Set time limits for detector
double Tmin = 2.5 / sqrt(Emax / VS2E);
double Tmax = 2.5 / sqrt(Emin / VS2E);
string detector_options = sprintf("banana, abs angle limits=[13 136] bins=300, time limits=[%g %g] bins=256", time_elastic + Tmin, time_elastic + Tmax);

# Set lambda monitor options
string lmon_options = sprintf("lambda limits=[%g %g] bins=100", lambda - dlambda / 2.0, lambda + dlambda / 2.0);

# Start of instrument
instrument ToF_Spectrometer

# Source component
component Source : Source_gen
  at [0, 0, 0]
  relative ABSOLUTE
  rotated [0, 0, 0]
  relative ABSOLUTE
  parameters
    radius = 0.155
    focus_xw = 0.03
    focus_yh = 0.055
    lambda0 = lambda
    dlambda = dlambda
    I1 = 1.4e12
    T1 = 43.7
    T2 = 137.2
    I2 = 2.08e12

# First guide component
component Guide0 : Guide_gravity
  at [0, 0, 2]
  relative Source
  rotated [0, 0, 0]
  relative ABSOLUTE
  parameters
    w1 = 0.03
    h1 = 0.055
    l = 2
    m = 1.2

component Guide0_copy : Guide_gravity

  at [0, 0, 1e-4]

component Chopper6 : DiskChopper
  at [0, 0, 1.2e-2 / 2]
  relative Guide2_dXY

    yheight = 0.06
    nu = rpm / 60
    delay = 252.78 * 11.97 * lambda * 1e-6

  at [0, 0, 2.143]

  rotated [0, 0, 0]

  relative Guide_DGS
  rotated [0, 0, 0]
  relative ABSOLUTE

# Sample component
component Sample : Isotropic_Sqw
  at [0, 0, 0]
  relative Sample_pos
  rotated [0, 45, 0]
  relative Sample_pos
  parameters
    Sqw_coh = coh
    Sqw_inc = inc
    xwidth = 0.05
    yheight = 0.06
    zdepth = 0.002
    p_interact = 0.99
  extend
    if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;

# Ideal detector
component Ideal_Det : Monitor_nD
  at [0, 0, 0]
  relative Sample_pos
  rotated [0, 0, 0]
  relative ABSOLUTE
  parameters
    yheight = 2
    restore_neutron = 1
    radius = 2.5
    options = detector_options

# Detector component
component Detector : PSD_Detector
  at [0, 0, 0]
  relative Sample_pos
  rotated [0, (136 - 13) / 2 + 13, 0]
  relative Sample_pos
  parameters
    nx = 640
    ny = 256
    radius = 2.5
    yheight = 2.0
    zdepth = 0.01
    threshold = 100
    PressureConv = 8
    PressureStop = 1
    dc = 0
    borderx = -1
    bordery = -1
    xChDivRelSigma = 0
    yChDivRelSigma = 0.0037
    filename = "NEAT.psd"
    FN_Conv = "Gas_tables/He3inHe.table"
    FN_Stop = "Gas_tables/He3inCF4.table"

# End of instrument
end

# Run the instrument

  seed = 123456789
  ncount = 1e6
  wait_s = 0
  output = "ToF_Spectrometer_results.txt"
  verbose = 1
end
